corrections.finding: Three findings; the rest stands. (1) Exhibit ONE assigns the four names otherwise than the item says: its "four four-cyclings" are its table's rows, first with 1 to 4, second with 5 to 8, third with 9 to 12 and fourth with 13 to 16 ("9-next-co-discovering opens a third four-cycling"), and 1, 5, 9, 13 / 2, 6, 10, 14 / 3, 7, 11, 15 / 4, 8, 12, 16 are four-cycling's four, its columns, existing and discovering, possibling, observing and same-existing, with "Four-cycling is observing prior-existing, possibling now-existing, discovering next-existing and same-existing." The numbers-to-names pairing in the item matches Exhibit ONE; the label "four four-cyclings" for the columns does not, and Exhibit ONE's own column words are dropped. Re-said with the rows as the four four-cyclings and the columns as four-cycling's four, with Exhibit ONE's words. (2) A side dropped in part and the closing taking one side: the source's one side is that the coarser grain's four are the four momentaries by their builds, a reference prior-existing with drift, a rate now-existing with jitter, a magnitude next-existing with heat and wear, a cost same-existing with a record; the item has only "each four is one momentary or is not", no laying, and its closing binary, "the ten lay onto the four four-cyclings by their seatings, or the four of the coarser grain are a different four from the four-cyclings", has the source's other side on both halves, that other side being "the ten's own seatings are the four momentaries, by code's numbers, and the coarser grain is a different four". Re-said with the first side's laying carried and the closing as the two sides the source holds. (3) A living-file word dropped: at the quoted sentence the rate's build is "jitter and margin"; the item has "jitter". Restored. Standing: the quoted sentence is word for word at the living file; each seating pairing matches the living file's "Ten in sequence..." sentence (1 and 9 opening, 2 and 10 observing from behind, 3 and 11 two-way, 4 and 12 sequencing, 5 and 13 middle and between, 6 and 14 completing, 7 and 15 parity and rate, 8 and 16 same-existing); the value is not held, the gathering-value file's two "Ten in sequence..." lines holding other values (one re-says "Natural Naming 4.9's one seating" as "its one name at Natural Naming 4.9"; the other parts at the shared seats 5 and 13 and 7 and 15 against the front's five bi-couplings), and its droplets on the four corners and on Natural Naming 6.2's eight clusters beside the four gatherings are other values too; no source, session, date, narrator or history; "seats", "build" and "grain" are the living file's own words at lines 740 and 742 and stay; file and section right. Aside, not corrected: the item's "from" is its own text's first 81 characters, where the brief has the source item's first 80. Amended after pass 7: the laying of the builds onto four-cycling's four is the source's own re-saying, said as a re-saying offered beside the sentence. Re-read after that amending: both sides stand whole and the closing decides nothing; the living file at its "Ten in sequence..." and "And with a coarser grain..." sentences seats the ten at code's numbers and folds them to four by build, and nowhere lays a reference, a rate, a magnitude and a cost onto prior-existing, now-existing, next-existing and same-existing, so that laying is the source's own re-saying and goes as a re-saying beside the sentence. One craft change at the phrase: "offered" is an -ed, a momentarying put behind as a thing at its end with an offerer over it (Natural Explaining 3.5, 3.2), and the gathering-value file's own form is "A re-saying beside it"; said "a re-saying beside this sentence", "this sentence" being the quoted one as at the item's opening, where "the sentence" sat beside "the sentence before it".

fixed.text: Two sayings part at which four the ten fold to. This sentence folds ten to four by their builds, a reference with drift, a rate with jitter and margin, a magnitude with heat and wear, a parity going along entering as cost with a record; the sentence before it seats each of the ten with now and eight up with next, an opening fixing as a place at 1 and 9, an observing fixing from behind at 2 and 10, a two-way fixing to one side at 3 and 11, a sequencing fixing to one beat at 4 and 12, a middle fixing as an end and a between fixing as a cut at 5 and 13, a completing fixing as a last at 6 and 14, a parity fixing as a magnitude and a rate fixing as a value at 7 and 15, a same-existing fixing as a store at 8 and 16. Exhibit ONE's four four-cyclings are first with 1 to 4, second with 5 to 8, third with 9 to 12 and fourth with 13 to 16, and four-cycling's four are 1, 5, 9, 13 existing and discovering, next-existing, 2, 6, 10, 14 possibling, now-existing, 3, 7, 11, 15 observing, prior-existing, and 4, 8, 12, 16 same-existing. By the seatings, a place, an end and a cut are next-existing, from-behind and a last are now-existing, a magnitude, a value and a side are prior-existing, a store and one beat are same-existing. By the builds, from-behind, a last and an end are one, a reference, a beat and a value one, a rate, a magnitude and a side one, a magnitude, and a place, a store and a cut one, a cost; and a re-saying beside this sentence lays these four onto four-cycling's four, a reference prior-existing with drift, a rate now-existing with jitter, a magnitude next-existing with heat and wear, a cost same-existing with a record. The four of the coarser grain are four-cycling's four by their builds, or the ten's seatings at code's numbers are four-cycling's four and the coarser grain is a different four.
